description: Combine the stock levels of the `north` and `south` warehouses. Return a list of records with `sku` and `total` (the on-hand count across both warehouses; a sku that only one warehouse holds counts just that count) for every sku whose total is below 10, sorted by `total` from lowest to highest, and alphabetically by `sku` among equal totals.

capabilities.description: Reads the on-hand count of every sku a warehouse holds, keyed by sku.
